title: Decision Arena harness: frozen, operator-paid capture of RISE's cases across deciders
acceptance: scripts/arena/arena.mjs capture asks openai (Decisions API), jev, kev, rules and rules-floor the 39 fixed cases through the browser's own request and admitAnswers, keeping raw and admitted decisions; tested with mocked fetch only.
A billed capture refuses under CI, without --bill-operator, from a dirty harness, and before cumulative cost would pass --max-usd (at most 20); keys are never written, printed or thrown; tested.

The run is written once (wx) as public/content/arena/run-<sha12>.json with index.json, schema syberlabs.decision-arena/v1; src/core/decision/arena-file.js refuses an unknown schema, a dirty harness and a hash/name mismatch; tested.

report re-derives scores (valid, out-of-menu, explicit and contrast agreement raw and admitted, stability, latency, cost per 1k) byte-identically, and calls lane C's calibration(rows) when scripts/arena/calibration.mjs exists.
Nothing under src/ imports the harness, and the app and dist/ never name api.openai.com or gpt-6-luna; tested.

evidence.note: node --test scripts/arena/arena.test.mjs: 13/13 pass on branch arena/harness (guards, split probe, refusal, keys never logged, budget, Kev not run, Jev cost, rules, mock run accepted and report byte-identical, src import guard, no OpenAI endpoint in src/public/dist). Mocked fetch only; no paid call.

npx vitest run src/core/decision src/core/system-design.test.js src/core/csp.test.js src/core/cloudflare-headers.test.js: 126/126 pass, including admitAnswers equivalence with validDecision in recommend.test.js.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: a --mock capture from a clean commit wrote a 3.0 MB run (585 results), readArenaRun accepted it, report printed byte-identical output twice with matchesRecorded true; the mock output was deleted, not committed. Not merged, not deployed, no billed run.

Harness built and verified with mocks; pull request open for review

summary: The benchmark harness for the Decision Arena: an operator-paid, offline capture frozen into a content-addressed file, scored deterministically. No billed run is part of this task.
